claim_under_test: Keeping one W witness per R key and synchronously cloning the root and witness keys preserves a separating family for Qexists versus Qjoin.
primary_falsifier: At least one legal original instance separates the pair but its one-witness-pruned instance does not; the prescribed synchronous one-witness clone family also does not separate the pair.

queries.Qexists: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM W WHERE W.r=R.r)
queries.Qjoin: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R JOIN W ON W.r=R.r

tiny_domain_control.enumeration: For each R subset of {0,1}, independently assign each w key to ABSENT or an r in R.
tiny_domain_control.coverage: Every legal database over these fixed domains, including empty tables; no isomorphism pruning.
tiny_domain_control.original_separation_characterization: Both W keys exist and have the same r target.
tiny_domain_control.interpretation_limit: Exhaustive only over the declared tiny domains; absence of a separator would never establish unbounded equivalence.

candidate_transform.pruning: Keep R unchanged. For each r with W witnesses, retain the lexicographically smallest W row by w key and delete the others.
candidate_transform.clone_scope: Clone only this fixed one-row seed, not each enumerated database; maximum remains two rows per table.

invalid_fixed_witness_key_clone.reason: Two different W rows share primary key w=0.

validation.primary_evaluator: Pure Python loops on set-valued rows
validation.cross_check: SQLite in-memory, PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON, both primary keys declared; compare both query counts per legal input.

stop_rules: Parent hashes this protocol and code before the only guarded worker run.
Stop immediately on evaluator disagreement, illegal supposedly legal input, unexpected count, more than 18 enumerated inputs, or worker CPU/wall cap.
When the predefined falsifier is observed, record REJECT_ONE_WITNESS_SEED_CLONING; finish only this fixed 18-instance audit and two clone checks, with no adaptive search.
No retries, larger domains, alternative seeds, solver, GPU, API calls, or code changes after seeing outputs. A failed harness is a failed run, not scientific support.
No experimental result permits an unbounded equivalence declaration or a claim that all possible small-counterexample bounds fail.
usage_receipt: results.json includes resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF), platform units, CPU elapsed, wall elapsed, and code SHA256.
literature_gate: The minimal E(r)=exists w W(w,r) fragment admits a definitional-view reduction to terminating embedded-dependency CQ equivalence. Reject bare computable-bound existence as a novelty claim for that fragment; broader tree/FK coverage remains unproved.
not_a_second_mechanism: The legality fixture and view reduction are checks of this same one-witness cloning proposal, not alternative research directions.
